constraints_append: Colonization demotion requires an exact candidate-organism match in direct history text from the same nonsterile respiratory compartment.
Tracheostomy, COPD, bronchiectasis, and other structural-airway context alone never demote a candidate.
A provisional model-derived contaminant label never produces a deterministic route change.
A sterile/systemic specimen label or independent exact hospital culture/PCR support blocks colonization demotion.
Colonization may move a candidate downward by at most one route level and never deletes the candidate.
Priority-to-Context requires explicit current not-infection language; Context-to-Audit and Audit-to-Hold additionally require weak analytical support.
Colonization evidence consumed at the route stage cannot be reused as independent support at a later promotion gate.
